articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. (Feb. 6, 2024) – American Healthcare REIT, Inc., (the “Company”), a self-managed real estate investment trust (“REIT”) that acquires, owns and operates a diversified portfolio of clinical healthcare real estate properties, focusing primarily on medical office buildings, senior housing, skilled nursing facilities, hospitals and other healthcare-related facilities, announced today the pricing of its public offering of 56,000,000 shares of its common stock at $12.00 per share.
articles.title: American Healthcare REIT Announces Pricing of Public Offering
